howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Draw or type your signature
howto.text: Use the canvas to draw with a finger or stylus, or type your name in a handwriting font.

howto.name: Place and apply
howto.text: Drag the signature to where you want it, resize as needed, click Sign. The PDF is returned with the signature stamped on the selected page.

faq.q: Is this a cryptographically valid signature?
faq.a: No — this places a visual signature image, like signing paper. For cryptographically verifiable signatures, use the Sign PDF tool with a certificate.

faq.q: Does my signature image stay on PrivaTools?
faq.a: No. It's used only to render the output PDF and is deleted immediately afterwards.

faq.q: Can I use a signature image I already have?
faq.a: Yes — upload a transparent PNG of your signature instead of drawing one.
